This assessment is intentionally cumulative. For every solution, state the
relevant definitions or hypotheses, show a manual argument, and use computation
only as a separately labeled verification.

## How to use this assessment

1. Complete one pass without notes and without a timer.
2. Mark confidence before checking any solution.
3. Classify each gap as conceptual, procedural, computational, or interpretive.
4. Return to the linked course outcomes and retry after spaced review.

::: {.callout-note}
## Assessment status

The infrastructure and scoring model are active. The full comprehensive item
bank remains in development and will expand during the curriculum content audit.
:::
